title: CulturePark: Boosting Cross-cultural Understanding in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the ability of LLMs to generate and understand culturally specific data through simulated dialogues. A component of this data is 'human beliefs', which is further categorized, with 'religious beliefs' being one of the measured sub-components (making up 31.31% of the 'human belief' data).
findings: The paper's primary finding is methodological. It shows that its CulturePark framework can generate a diverse dataset of cross-cultural dialogues. A statistical analysis of this generated data reveals that 'religious beliefs' constitute a significant portion (31.31%) of the 'human belief' category. The paper demonstrates that fine-tuning LLMs on this culturally-rich data, which includes religious perspectives, improves their performance on downstream tasks like content moderation and cultural alignment, but it does not analyze biases or knowledge related to any specific religion.
